8311.description: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!$B$BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8311.objectivesText: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.  Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.$B$BReturn to Jesper at the Stormwind Orphanage with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.
8311.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8312.description: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!$B$BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8312.objectivesText: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village.  Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.$B$BReturn to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.
8312.title: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

8373.areaDescription: Clean up a stink bomb that's been dropped on Southshore!
8373.description: The thing I hate the most about Hallow's End are the stink bombs the Forsaken use on Southshore.  Who knew that celebrating liberation would have to involve such a smelly mess?$B$BDuring Hallow's End, use this cleaner to remove any nasty stink bombs the Horde may drop here in the village.  It uses the power of pine to fight funky smells.$B$BDo your part to keep Southshore clean, and I'll give you some Hallow's End treats I'm sure you'll enjoy.  We have a deal?
8373.objectivesText: Use a Stink Bomb Cleaner to remove any Forsaken Stink Bomb that's been dropped on Southshore.  Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore when you're done.
8373.title: The Power of Pine

8492.description: Hey there, $c, you look fit enough to contribute to the war effort! We need all of the help that we can get here to put together the materiel needed for the Ahn'Qiraj War and it's your lucky day.$B$BI'm collecting copper bars in stacks of twenty. It's for a worthy cause, what do you say? Do you think you could help out the Alliance?
8492.objectivesText: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8492.title: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!

8494.description: Well hello there, $g Mr. : Ms.; Fancypants, aren't you a sight for sore eyes. In case you hadn't heard while you were out there "adventuring", the Alliance has been gearing up for a war in Ahn'Qiraj and is in need of iron bars... a whole mess of 'em. Bring them to me in stacks of twenty. We can count on you, right, $c?
8494.objectivesText: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8494.title: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!

8499.description: It is very kind of you to inquire about the needs that the Alliance has. In addition to all of the other collection efforts underway, we are in need of a great quantity of thorium bars, which is the task that I am in charge of. The thorium will be used in the creation of many different things for the war, foremost of which is the construction of a battalion of steam tanks to be airlifted into Silithus as soon as they are completed. Can you aid us in this endeavor, $c?
8499.objectivesText: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8499.title: The Alliance Needs Thorium Bars!

8503.description: So, $c, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... in any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!
8503.objectivesText: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8503.title: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!

8505.description: $C, the purple lotus is a flower with a plentitude of uses. I am here at the request of the Alliance as an authority on those applications, to preserve the herbs collected and to ensure that their war effort acquires enough purple lotus to sustain whatever function they plan for it.$B$BI would like for you to travel out into the world and return to me with some of these flowers. Is that something that you can do?
8505.objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8505.title: The Alliance Needs Purple Lotus!

8509.description: I'll keep it simple and to the point, $c. The Alliance needs to collect a large quantity of Arthas' Tears for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Don't ask me what for; I'm just following orders. But I'd like you to gather up as many of the herbs as you can and bring them back to me here. Are you willing to do that?
8509.objectivesText: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8509.title: The Alliance Needs Arthas' Tears!

8511.description: We Stoneflayers have a long history of being skinners, $c. That's why the Alliance has asked my family to help out with the collection of light leather for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm here to see to it that the leather is tanned correctly for whatever they want to put it to use for. But we need your help.$B$BSince I have to be here doing that, I need you to go out and collect the skins, returning them to me here. What do you say, $g lad : lass;, will you give it a go?
8511.objectivesText: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8511.title: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!

8513.description: Yes $g sir : ma'am;, I have been charged with collecting and tracking all of the medium leather gathered for the war effort. If you have the wherewithal to gather medium leather, from whatever source, then please bring them to me here. I sure would appreciate a hand with this if you can spare the time.
8513.objectivesText: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8513.title: The Alliance Needs Medium Leather!

8515.description: Oh boy, this is going to be great! $C, the Ahn'Qiraj war effort is in full swing, and I've been put in charge of keeping track of all of the thick leather that comes in. We'll make tons of things with it, but first we need to get a ton of it. And I mean that literally! That's where you come in.$B$BSo, do you think you can go out there and bring me back a nice, fat stack of thick leather? Do yah, do yah?!
8515.objectivesText: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8515.title: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!

8517.description: The war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to be long and bloody. It is a very wise thing that the Alliance is doing by enlisting the aid of you, and those like you, to build up the materiel necessary before plunging headlong into conflict.$B$BI have been asked to head up the collection of linen bandages for the war, and I am hoping that you are going to assist me in amassing as many as we need. It is no light matter, but at least the linen bandages are the least difficult to create. Are you with us, $c?
8517.objectivesText: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8517.title: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!

8520.description: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.$B$BDo you think you can help me out, $c?
8520.objectivesText: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8520.title: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!

8522.description: Argue the merits of the war if you will, $c, but it has already been set in motion. Look around you at your family and friends, and then ask yourself what it is that you can do to see to it that if they are involved, they will have every advantage to survive the conflagration.$B$BTo that end, I am collecting runecloth bandages here from whatever source. Would you like to make a donation?
8522.objectivesText: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8522.title: The Alliance Needs Runecloth Bandages!

8524.description: Hey there, friend! If I were to say to you, 'Don't you think that soldiers should have food to eat like anyone else?', you would of course reply, 'yes'. I agree with you 110%! I'm glad we're in accord. All I need for you to do is to head out there, fish up a whole bunch of raw rainbow fin albacore, and then cook it all up and bring it back to me right here. Mmm, mmm, I can taste it already.
8524.objectivesText: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8524.title: The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!

8526.description: Oh, how's it going, $c? I see that you're interested in maybe gathering up food for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj? Somehow my dad thought that it would be a good learning experience for me if I were to volunteer to help out here. Big mistake. I don't even like to eat meat.$B$BAnyway, if you feel like it, you could bring me back a lot of roast raptor. Apparently that's what all of the soldiers are going to want.
8526.objectivesText: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8526.title: The Alliance Needs Roast Raptor!

8528.description: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young $c. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.$B$BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
8528.objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8528.title: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!

8530.description: $C, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.
8530.objectivesText: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
8530.title: The Alliance Needs Singed Corestones!

8532.description: So glad that you've decided to help out here. Not everyone would, so I need to make sure you understand what it is that I need. Copper bars, not copper ore. We don't have the time or people to do all of the smelting ourselves, so if you would be so kind as to take care of that, your efforts will be duly noted. Is that something that you can handle, $c?
8532.objectivesText: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8532.title: The Horde Needs Copper Bars!

8542.description: Lok'tar, $r, I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. But I cannot do that without your help.$B$BSo I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. I think I'm going to need more than I can count.
8542.objectivesText: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8542.title: The Horde Needs Tin Bars!

8545.description: $C, the war it is comin' and the only thing we can do is prepare for it. That be where you and I can help each other, mon. Ya see, they put me in charge of collectin' all the mithril bars we be needin' ta build for all the things we gonna need. An I still be needin' more!$B$BSo, I be hopin' that you can get out there an mine us up some mithril, then smelt it into bars. Sound like something you can do for us?
8545.objectivesText: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8545.title: The Horde Needs Mithril Bars!

8549.description: It is said that every generation must face a defining trial. I fear the Ahn'Qiraj War will be the crucible in which our mettle is tested. So we prepare, and in so doing find what we are made of.$B$BI have volunteered to help the Horde by gathering as much peacebloom as possible, so that it can be made into potions for the war. I hope that you are here to lend me your aid. If so, then I need you to bring back to me a good quantity of the herb. Will you assist me, $c?
8549.objectivesText: Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8549.title: The Horde Needs Peacebloom!

8580.description: Hey, $c. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!$B$BPele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
8580.objectivesText: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8580.title: The Horde Needs Firebloom!

8582.description: The purple lotus, $c, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.$B$BThat's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
8582.objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8582.title: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!

8588.description: Since we're preparing for war, it might be best if we get all of the goods we need first, don't you think, mon? One of the staples of the war materiel that we're producing is heavy leather. We'll use it for just about everything, from reinforcement to armor, and good old plain tarps too.$B$BBut first we need to get our hands on more of it. That's your job, $c. Sharpen your knife and bring me back a bundle. Then we'll talk further.
8588.objectivesText: Bring 10 Heavy Leather to Skinner Jamani at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8588.title: The Horde Needs Heavy Leather!

8590.description: I'm glad that you decided to speak to me about this, $c. It looks like the Horde's preparations for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War are in full swing. But you and I still need to do our part.$B$BI've been asked to collect a great number of thick leather skins for use in all manner of war materiel, and I need you to help me by going out there and gathering them up. There's honor and the gratitude of the Horde in it for you should you decide to help. Will you?
8590.objectivesText: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Sergeant Umala at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8590.title: The Horde Needs Thick Leather!

8600.description: I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, $c? But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes? $B$BWell, no matter, I have a task for you. In service to the Horde, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. This is something that you will do, no?
8600.objectivesText: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8600.title: The Horde Needs Rugged Leather!

8604.description: Greetings, $c. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.$B$BIf you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
8604.objectivesText: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8604.title: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!

8607.description: I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, $c, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
8607.objectivesText: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8607.title: The Horde Needs Mageweave Bandages!

8609.description: It appears inevitable that the Horde and Alliance are on a collision course for war at Ahn'Qiraj. Surprisingly, it is not a war with each other, but rather with the silithid, and whatever force controls them. Also surprisingly, both sides are doing their part to gather the resources necessary to wage a successful war.$B$BI am collecting runecloth bandages to distribute to the soldiers, but I won't be successful without assistance, hopefully yours. Is this something that you can aid me with, $c?
8609.objectivesText: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Stoneguard Clayhoof at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8609.title: The Horde Needs Runecloth Bandages!

8611.description: I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, $c. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!$B$BThey have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. You got all that?
8611.objectivesText: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8611.title: The Horde Needs Lean Wolf Steaks!

8613.description: It be a nice day for fishin', don't'cha think mon? Good thing, cuz I be needin' a lot of fish it lookin' like. The Horde, they askin' me to be in charge of collectin' a ton of the spotted yellowtail for them. They say they needin' it for the war they getting' ready for at Ahn'Qiraj. I say to them I do the best I can. So I be needin' to get some help. You gonna be helpin' me, $c?
8613.objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Fisherman Lin'do at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8613.title: The Horde Needs Spotted Yellowtail!

8615.description: The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, $c. All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.$B$BThus, we gather what food we can. I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. Can you aid me with this task, $c?
8615.objectivesText: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8615.title: The Horde Needs Baked Salmon!

8617.description: The time has come for you to contribute to the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, $c. Gone are the halcyon days of whiling away your time in leisure. Now it is time to serve me and the Horde, and I assure you that I am not as forgiving as the Warchief.$B$BYou will gather your forces, a guild if you have one, and invade the Molten Core. Inside you will find that the denizens of the place have singed corestones. Bring these back to me in large quantities.
8617.objectivesText: Bring 50 singed corestones to General Zog in Durotar.
8617.title: The Horde Needs Singed Corestones!

8792.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8792.objectivesText: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
8792.title: The Horde Needs Your Help!

8827.description: I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Ironforge. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.$b$bBut you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.
8827.objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
8827.title: Winter's Presents

8828.description: I hear Great-father Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.$b$bBut you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Great-father Winter has some presents with your name on them.
8828.objectivesText: Speak with Great-father Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
8828.title: Winter's Presents

8860.description: Stormwind is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day long today you can get free booze, and at night they'll put on a firework show!  It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!$B$BWell anyway, Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!$B$BThanks, $n!  Innkeeper Allison is in the Gilded Rose, in the Trade District of Stormwind.
8860.objectivesText: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to Innkeeper Allison in Stormwind.
8860.title: New Year Celebrations!

8861.description: Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!$B$BIt should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!$B$BWell anyway, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!$B$BThanks, $n!  Innkeeper Pala is in the inn near the bridge to Hunter's Rise.
8861.objectivesText: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff.
8861.title: New Year Celebrations!

8867.description: Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.$B$BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!$B$BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor.  Try using some of the launchers around here, $n.
8867.objectivesText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
8867.title: Lunar Fireworks

8870.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8870.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8870.title: The Lunar Festival

8871.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8871.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Park District in Stormwind.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8871.title: The Lunar Festival

8874.title: The Lunar Festival

8875.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. 8875.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8875.title: The Lunar Festival

8897.description: I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.$b$bWould she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.$b$bAnyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.
8897.objectivesText: Deliver Lieutenant Heldric's Carefully Penned Note to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8897.title: Dearest Colara,

8898.description: I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!$b$bThe mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.$b$bIf you're heading that way, could you help me?
8898.objectivesText: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8898.title: Dearest Colara,

8899.description: How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.$b$bThese mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.$b$bI've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
8899.objectivesText: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8899.title: Dearest Colara,

8900.description: She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?$b$bBut after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.$b$bWhen I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.
8900.objectivesText: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8900.title: Dearest Elenia,

8901.description: Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the Undercity, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the Forsaken.$b$bBut now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.$b$bIf you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to Mulgore. I hope that she will say yes.
8901.objectivesText: Deliver the Carefully Written Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8901.title: Dearest Elenia,

8902.description: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.$b$bPerhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.$b$bI'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
8902.objectivesText: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8902.title: Dearest Elenia,

8903.description: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the Alliance itself.$b$bJust think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? Something must be done.$b$bGo to one of the guards here in Stormwind and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
8903.objectivesText: Get a Stormwind Guard's Card and return it to Aristan Mottar in Stormwind.
8903.title: Dangerous Love

8904.description: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.$b$bIt's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.$b$bFind one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
8904.objectivesText: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.
8904.title: Dangerous Love

9247.description: $n,$B$BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.$B$B$n, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
9247.objectivesText: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9247.title: The Keeper's Call

9260.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9260.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9260.title: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind

9292.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
9292.objectivesText: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
9292.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal

9310.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
9310.objectivesText: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal

9322.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$b$bMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.objectivesText: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor

9323.description: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$b$bYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$b$b Return once your journey is done.
9323.objectivesText: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9323.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms

9367.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9367.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
9367.title: The Festival of Fire

9368.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.title: The Festival of Fire

9388.description: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $n. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$b$bYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
9388.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9388.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor

9389.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$b$bMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
9389.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9389.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms

9415.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$b$bWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$b$bNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
9415.objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9415.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall

9416.description: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.$b$bThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.$b$bGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
9416.objectivesText: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9416.title: Report to General Kirika

9419.description: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.$b$bHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.$b$bIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
9419.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9419.title: Scouring the Desert

9422.description: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$b$bBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$b$bI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
9422.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9422.title: Scouring the Desert

65593.description: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.$b$bMy scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.$b$bIn Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.$b$bThey toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593.objectivesText: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
65593.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65597.description: The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.$b$bThe demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, $n. You must subdue it fully.$b$bOnly then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597.objectivesText: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
65597.title: The Binding

65601.description:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $n, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601.title: Love Hurts

65602.description:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602.objectivesText: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
65602.title: What Is Love?

65603.description:
The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center.

Then the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world.

A sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it.

If you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.
65603.objectivesText: Using the Wooden Figurine, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Wooden Figurine to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
65603.title: The Binding

65604.description:
Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $n. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a warlock's final mistake.

When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604.objectivesText: Using the Withered Scarf, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Withered Scarf to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65604.title: The Binding

65610.description:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610.objectivesText: Investigate Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65610.title: Wish You Were Here

76156.description: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, $c. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156.objectivesText: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76156.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160.description: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.objectivesText: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76240.description:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240.objectivesText: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76240.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Delgren the Purifier might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

78088.description:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.title: A Strange Artifact

78089.description:
There's a powerful darkness about this orb. Its nature is clearly demonic, but past that it is beyond my ability to discern its purpose.

Take the orb to the one known as Katherine the Pure in the Stormwind Cathedral. Consult with her for advice on the orb.
78089.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
78089.title: Advice From Stormwind

78090.description:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $n. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
78090.objectivesText: Find the warlock sanctum within Stormwind and seek advice on the orb.
78090.title: A Second Opinion

78091.description:
I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.

The warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.

When you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.
78091.objectivesText: Collect 14 Summoner's Salt from Blackrock Summoners in Redridge Mountains, then return to Ursula Deline in Stormwind.
78091.title: Earning Your Salt

78092.description:
The tendrils of sentience reaching out from this orb are too much for even an experienced warlock like myself to withstand for long. I am reluctant to admit this, $n, but the orb must be destroyed.

The orb is nearly impervious, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I have heard that such a blade is present in Ashenvale--at the site where the pit lord Mannoroth was destroyed.

Gather motes of the fallen demon's essence there, then shatter the orb upon the blade.
78092.objectivesText: Gather 12 Motes of Mannoroth from demons in Ashenvale. Bring them along with the Orb of Althalaxx to the Spear of Mannoroth at Demon Fall Canyon.
78092.title: It Must Be Destroyed

78093.description: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectivesText: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.title: Return to Delgren

78261.description:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, $n.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261.objectivesText: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78261.title: The Horn of Xelthos

78676.description:
<A note sits in the chest>

Glad to have you back, $n.

The latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.

It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.

Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.

- C
78676.objectivesText: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78676.title: The Eye of Bhossca

78823.description: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

78830.description:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.objectivesText: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

78916.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78916.objectivesText: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
78916.title: The Heart of the Void

78917.description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78917.objectivesText: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
78917.title: The Heart of the Void

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79008.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.title: ... and that note you found

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79098.description: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
79098.objectivesText: Bring the Silverwing Sentinel Charm to Kazragore, Far Seer, at the Bonfire base in Ashenvale.
79098.title: Clear the Forest!

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79229.description:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.objectivesText: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.title: Highway Robbery

79235.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $n. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectivesText: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.title: On the Lam

79236.description:
You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.

The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.

I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
79236.objectivesText: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
79236.title: Cherry for Your Thoughts?

79242.description:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
79242.objectivesText: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.title: No Honor Among Thieves

79358.description:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $n. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79360.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles.
79360.description:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.title: Elemental Aid

79361.description:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79362.description:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362.objectivesText: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
79362.title: Grant's Shield

79363.description:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Defias Night Blades and $1oa Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
79363.title: Silvia's Sword

79364.completionText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.description:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364.objectivesText: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.title: Eyes on the Sky

79365.description: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectivesText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79366.completionText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Freewind Post and report what happened.
79366.description:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $n. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
79366.title: Heed My Call

79442.description: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442.objectivesText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
79442.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79492.description: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!

objectives.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

79492.objectivesText: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.
79492.title: Metzen the Reindeer

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79731.description:
<The ancient glyphs resolve into words before your eyes.>

When Zul'Kunda's fountain runs with the waters of the holy spring, the gods grant their blessing.
79731.objectivesText: Solve the riddle of the scroll. Once you've done that, Hemet Nesingwary might like to hear the tale.
79731.title: The Troll Scroll

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79951.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79974.description:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectivesText: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.title: Wet Job

79975.description:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.objectivesText: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
79975.title: Eagle's Fist

79976.description:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.objectivesText: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

81570.description: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.$B$BBut don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
81570.objectivesText: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
81570.title: Jarl Needs a Blade

81730.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard. Defeat worgen there and return to me.
81730.objectivesText: Defeat 10 Nightmare Runners and 10 Nightmare Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81730.title: Duskwood Mission I: Defeat Worgen

81731.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat ogres there and return to me.
81731.objectivesText: Defeat 3 Deranged Ogres and 3 Demented Fire Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81731.title: Duskwood Mission II: Defeat Ogres

81732.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
81732.objectivesText: Defeat 3 Wyrmkin Terrorwalkers and 10 Nightterror Whelps in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81732.title: Duskwood Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin

81733.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Thalinar there and return to me.
81733.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Thalinar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep inside the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81733.title: Duskwood Mission IV: Ogre Intelligence

81734.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.
81734.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Dorilar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the barn at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81734.title: Duskwood Mission V: Worgen Intelligence

81735.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead . Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Amalia there and return to me.
81735.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Amalia in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the farmhouse at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81735.title: Duskwood Mission VI: Dragon Intelligence

81736.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Shadowscythe and deliver it to me.
81736.objectivesText: Recover the Shadowscythe in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion upstairs in the farmhouse at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81736.title: Duskwood Mission VII: Recover Shadowscythe

81737.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an Ogre Magi Text and deliver it to me.
81737.objectivesText: Recover an Ogre Magi Text in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion within the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81737.title: Duskwood Mission VIII: Recover Ogre Magi text

81738.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Retrieve an Unhatched Green Dragon Egg and deliver it to me.
81738.objectivesText: Recover an Unhatched Green Dragon Egg in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion from the Yorgen Farmstead near the large stump in the fields and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81738.title: Duskwood Mission IX: Recover Dragon Egg

81739.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Nightmare Moss from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
81739.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nightmare Moss in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81739.title: Duskwood Mission X: Nightmare Moss

81740.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Cold Iron Ore from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.
81740.objectivesText: Gather 10 Cold Iron Ore in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81740.title: Duskwood Mission XI: Cold Iron Ore

81741.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Dream-Touched Dragonscales from dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.
81741.objectivesText: Gather 10 Dream-Touched Dragonscales in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81741.title: Duskwood Mission XII: Dream-Touched Dragonscale

81742.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat the dragon Ylanthrius there and return to me.
81742.objectivesText: Defeat Ylanthrius in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead field and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81742.title: Duskwood Mission XIII: Defeat Ylanthrius

81743.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat the ogre warlord Vvarc'zul there and return to me.
81743.objectivesText: Defeat Vvarc'zul in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep in the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81743.title: Duskwood Mission XIV: Defeat Vvarc'zul

81744.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Defeat the worgen leader Amokarok there and return to me.
81744.objectivesText: Defeat Amokarok in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at a campsite near the barn in the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81744.title: Duskwood Mission XV: Defeat Amokarok

81745.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Kroll Mountainshade there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81745.objectivesText: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade from the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the guest house at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81745.title: Duskwood Mission XVI: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade

81746.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Darmstead. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Alara Grovemender there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81746.objectivesText: Rescue Alara Grovemender in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the stable at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81746.title: Duskwood Mission XVII: Rescue Alara Grovemender

81747.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Elenora Marshwalker there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81747.objectivesText: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the ruins of a farmhouse near the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81747.title: Duskwood Mission XVIII: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker

86574.description:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
86574.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86576.description:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86613.description: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.objectivesText: Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.title: Excavation Tools

86614.description: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.objectivesText: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.title: Silver of the Waves

86667.description:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.objectivesText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.
86667.title: Snowbound

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

86784.description:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
86784.title: Sticks and Bones

87288.description:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
87288.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87318.description:
Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318.title: Hearts of the Lost

87491.areaDescription: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
87491.description:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!
